title: Beal Conjecture — Release Guard, Genuine Frey Residual, and Typed R=T Patching — v8.4.0
description: Version 8.3.0 records an audited conditional milestone in Lean 4. Exact-divisibility proofs no longer live in the Wiles plan or Galois edge witnesses: the odd-prime Tate interface derives each edge from the canonical Frey model and its conductor. The terminal 2-adic exponent-one premise is explicit model-indexed data. The patching layer carries residual-representation, Hecke-attachment, deformation, comparison, finite-level action, and diamond-specialization data. The final route remains conditional on exactly three named mathematical interfaces—frey_conductor_data, tate_step2_odd_prime_external, and wiles_modularity—and two unconstructed data suppliers, TwoAdicExponentOneSupplier and EnrichedPlanSupplier. This is not an unconditional proof of the Beal Conjecture.
